18: package org.apache.lucene.analysis.opennlp;
19: 
20: import java.text.BreakIterator;
21: import java.text.CharacterIterator;
22: import opennlp.tools.sentdetect.SentenceDetectorME;
23: import opennlp.tools.util.Span;
24: import org.apache.lucene.analysis.opennlp.tools.NLPSentenceDetectorOp;
25: import org.apache.lucene.analysis.util.CharArrayIterator;
26: 
27: /** A {@link BreakIterator} that splits sentences using an OpenNLP sentence chunking model. */
28: public final class OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator extends BreakIterator {
29: 
30:   private CharacterIterator text;
31:   private int currentSentence;
32:   private int[] sentenceStarts;
33:   private NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceOp;
34: 
35:   public OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceOp) {
36:     this.sentenceOp = sentenceOp;
37:   }
38: 
39:   @Override
40:   public int current() {
41:     return text.getIndex();
42:   }
43: 
44:   @Override
45:   public int first() {
46:     currentSentence = 0;
47:     text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
48:     return current();
49:   }
50: 
51:   @Override
52:   public int last() {
53:     if (sentenceStarts.length > 0) {
54:       currentSentence = sentenceStarts.length - 1;
55:       text.setIndex(text.getEndIndex());
56:     } else { // there are no sentences; both the first and last positions are the begin index
57:       currentSentence = 0;
58:       text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
59:     }
60:     return current();
61:   }
62: 
63:   @Override
64:   public int next() {
65:     if (text.getIndex() == text.getEndIndex() || 0 == sentenceStarts.length) {
66:       return DONE;
67:     } else if (currentSentence < sentenceStarts.length - 1) {
68:       text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[++currentSentence]);
69:       return current();
70:     } else {
71:       return last();
72:     }
73:   }
74: 
75:   @Override
76:   public int following(int pos) {
77:     if (pos < text.getBeginIndex() || pos > text.getEndIndex()) {
78:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset out of bounds");
79:     } else if (0 == sentenceStarts.length) {
80:       text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
81:       return DONE;
82:     } else if (pos >= sentenceStarts[sentenceStarts.length - 1]) {
83:       // this conflicts with the javadocs, but matches actual behavior (Oracle has a bug in
84:       // something)
85:       // https://bugs.openjdk.java.net/browse/JDK-8015110
86:       text.setIndex(text.getEndIndex());
87:       currentSentence = sentenceStarts.length - 1;
88:       return DONE;
89:     } else { // there are at least two sentences
90:       currentSentence = (sentenceStarts.length - 1) / 2; // start search from the middle
91:       moveToSentenceAt(pos, 0, sentenceStarts.length - 2);
92:       text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[++currentSentence]);
93:       return current();
94:     }
95:   }
96: 
97:   /** Binary search over sentences */
98:   private void moveToSentenceAt(int pos, int minSentence, int maxSentence) {
99:     if (minSentence != maxSentence) {
100:       if (pos < sentenceStarts[currentSentence]) {
101:         int newMaxSentence = currentSentence - 1;
102:         currentSentence = minSentence + (currentSentence - minSentence) / 2;
103:         moveToSentenceAt(pos, minSentence, newMaxSentence);
104:       } else if (pos >= sentenceStarts[currentSentence + 1]) {
105:         int newMinSentence = currentSentence + 1;
106:         currentSentence = maxSentence - (maxSentence - currentSentence) / 2;
107:         moveToSentenceAt(pos, newMinSentence, maxSentence);
108:       }
109:     } else {
110:       assert currentSentence == minSentence;
111:       assert pos >= sentenceStarts[currentSentence];
112:       assert (currentSentence == sentenceStarts.length - 1 && pos <= text.getEndIndex())
113:           || pos < sentenceStarts[currentSentence + 1];
114:     }
115:     // we have arrived - nothing to do
116:   }
117: 
118:   @Override
119:   public int previous() {
120:     if (text.getIndex() == text.getBeginIndex()) {
121:       return DONE;
122:     } else {
123:       if (0 == sentenceStarts.length) {
124:         text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
125:         return DONE;
126:       }
127:       if (text.getIndex() == text.getEndIndex()) {
128:         text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
129:       } else {
130:         text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[--currentSentence]);
131:       }
132:       return current();
133:     }
134:   }
135: 
136:   @Override
137:   public int preceding(int pos) {
138:     int begin = iteratorBegin();
139:     Span[] spans = sentenceOp.getLastSpans();
140:     int lastTextLength = sentenceOp.getLastTextLength();
141:     int lastSpanCount = sentenceOp.getLastSpanCount();
142:     SentenceDetectorME splitter = sentenceOp.getSentenceSplitter();
143:     CharArrayIterator lastChars = sentenceOp.getLastChars();
144:     int bufferedLength = lastChars.getLength();
145:     int bufferedStart = lastChars.getStart();
146:     int detectedCount = splitter == null ? lastSpanCount : spans.length;
147:     int textLen = Math.max(lastTextLength, bufferedLength);
148:     if (detectedCount > 0) {
149:       textLen = Math.max(textLen, spans[0].getEnd());
150:     }
151:     if (pos < begin || pos > begin + textLen + bufferedStart) {
152:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("offset out of bounds");
153:     }
154:     if (0 == detectedCount) {
155:       resetToBegin();
156:       currentSentence = 0;
157:       return DONE;
158:     }
159:     int firstStart = spans[0].getStart() + begin + bufferedStart;
160:     if (pos < firstStart) {
161:       // this conflicts with the javadocs, but matches actual behavior (Oracle has a bug in
162:       // something)
163:       // https://bugs.openjdk.java.net/browse/JDK-8015110
164:       resetToBegin();
165:       currentSentence = 0;
166:       return DONE;
167:     } else {
168:       currentSentence = lastSpanCount / 2; // start search from the middle
169:       moveToSentenceAt(pos, 0, lastSpanCount - 1);
170:       if (0 == currentSentence) {
171:         resetToBegin();
172:         return DONE;
173:       } else {
174:         goToStoredSentence(--currentSentence);
175:         return current();
176:       }
177:     }
178:   }
179: 
180:   private int iteratorBegin() {
181:     return text.getBeginIndex();
182:   }
183: 
184:   private void resetToBegin() {
185:     text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
186:   }
187: 
188:   private void goToStoredSentence(int index) {
189:     text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[index]);
190:   }
191: 
192:   @Override
193:   public int next(int n) {
194:     currentSentence += n;
195:     if (n < 0) {
196:       if (text.getIndex() == text.getEndIndex()) {
197:         ++currentSentence;
198:       }
199:       if (currentSentence < 0) {
200:         currentSentence = 0;
201:         text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
202:         return DONE;
203:       } else {
204:         text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
205:       }
206:     } else if (n > 0) {
207:       if (currentSentence >= sentenceStarts.length) {
208:         currentSentence = sentenceStarts.length - 1;
209:         text.setIndex(text.getEndIndex());
210:         return DONE;
211:       } else {
212:         text.setIndex(sentenceStarts[currentSentence]);
213:       }
214:     }
215:     return current();
216:   }
217: 
218:   @Override
219:   public CharacterIterator getText() {
220:     return text;
221:   }
222: 
223:   @Override
224:   public void setText(CharacterIterator newText) {
225:     text = newText;
226:     text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
227:     currentSentence = 0;
228:     Span[] spans = sentenceOp.splitSentences(characterIteratorToString());
229:     sentenceStarts = new int[spans.length];
230:     for (int i = 0; i < spans.length; ++i) {
231:       // Adjust start positions to match those of the passed-in CharacterIterator
232:       sentenceStarts[i] = spans[i].getStart() + text.getBeginIndex();
233:     }
234:   }
235: 
236:   private String characterIteratorToString() {
237:     String fullText;
238:     if (text instanceof CharArrayIterator) {
239:       CharArrayIterator charArrayIterator = (CharArrayIterator) text;
240:       fullText =
241:           new String(
242:               charArrayIterator.getText(),
243:               charArrayIterator.getStart(),
244:               charArrayIterator.getLength());
245:     } else {
246:       // TODO: is there a better way to extract full text from arbitrary CharacterIterators?
247:       StringBuilder builder = new StringBuilder();
248:       for (char ch = text.first(); ch != CharacterIterator.DONE; ch = text.next()) {
249:         builder.append(ch);
250:       }
251:       fullText = builder.toString();
252:       text.setIndex(text.getBeginIndex());
253:     }
254:     return fullText;
255:   }
256: }

(End of file - total 256 lines)

18: package org.apache.lucene.analysis.opennlp;
19: 
20: import java.io.IOException;
21: import java.text.BreakIterator;
22: import java.text.CharacterIterator;
23: import org.apache.lucene.analysis.opennlp.tools.NLPSentenceDetectorOp;
24: import org.apache.lucene.analysis.opennlp.tools.OpenNLPOpsFactory;
25: import org.apache.lucene.analysis.util.CharArrayIterator;
26: import org.apache.lucene.tests.util.LuceneTestCase;
27: import org.apache.lucene.util.ClasspathResourceLoader;
28: import org.junit.BeforeClass;
29: 
30: public class TestOpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator extends LuceneTestCase {
31: 
32:   private static final String TEXT
33:       //
34:       //         111
35:       //
36:       // 111111111122222222223333333333444444444455555555556666666666777777777788888888889999999999000
37:       // 0123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890123456789012
38:       =
39:       "Sentence number 1 has 6 words. Sentence number 2, 5 words. And finally, sentence number 3 has 8 words.";
40:   private static final String[] SENTENCES =
41:       new String[] {
42:         "Sentence number 1 has 6 words. ",
43:         "Sentence number 2, 5 words. ",
44:         "And finally, sentence number 3 has 8 words."
45:       };
46:   private static final String PADDING = " Word. Word. ";
47:   private static final String sentenceModelFile = "en-test-sent.bin";
48: 
49:   @BeforeClass
50:   public static void populateCache() throws IOException {
51:     OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceModel(
52:         sentenceModelFile, new ClasspathResourceLoader(TestOpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator.class));
53:   }
54: 
55:   public void testThreeSentences() throws Exception {
56:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
57:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
58:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
59:     bi.setText(TEXT); // String is converted to StringCharacterIterator
60:     do3SentenceTest(bi);
61: 
62:     bi.setText(getCharArrayIterator(TEXT));
63:     do3SentenceTest(bi);
64:   }
65: 
66:   private CharacterIterator getCharArrayIterator(String text) {
67:     return getCharArrayIterator(text, 0, text.length());
68:   }
69: 
70:   private CharacterIterator getCharArrayIterator(String text, int start, int length) {
71:     CharArrayIterator charArrayIterator =
72:         new CharArrayIterator() {
73:           // Lie about all surrogates to the sentence tokenizer,
74:           // instead we treat them all as SContinue so we won't break around them.
75:           @Override
76:           protected char jreBugWorkaround(char ch) {
77:             return ch >= 0xD800 && ch <= 0xDFFF ? 0x002C : ch;
78:           }
79:         };
80:     charArrayIterator.setText(text.toCharArray(), start, length);
81:     return charArrayIterator;
82:   }
83: 
84:   private void do3SentenceTest(BreakIterator bi) {
85:     assertEquals(0, bi.current());
86:     assertEquals(0, bi.first());
87:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[0], TEXT.substring(bi.current(), bi.next()));
88:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[1], TEXT.substring(bi.current(), bi.next()));
89:     int current = bi.current();
90:     assertEquals(bi.getText().getEndIndex(), bi.next());
91:     int next = bi.current();
92:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[2], TEXT.substring(current, next));
93:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.next());
94: 
95:     assertEquals(TEXT.length(), bi.last());
96:     int end = bi.current();
97:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[2], TEXT.substring(bi.previous(), end));
98:     end = bi.current();
99:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[1], TEXT.substring(bi.previous(), end));
100:     end = bi.current();
101:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[0], TEXT.substring(bi.previous(), end));
102:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.previous());
103:     assertEquals(0, bi.current());
104: 
105:     assertEquals(59, bi.following(39));
106:     assertEquals(59, bi.following(31));
107:     assertEquals(31, bi.following(30));
108: 
109:     assertEquals(0, bi.preceding(57));
110:     assertEquals(0, bi.preceding(58));
111:     assertEquals(31, bi.preceding(59));
112: 
113:     assertEquals(0, bi.first());
114:     assertEquals(59, bi.next(2));
115:     assertEquals(0, bi.next(-2));
116:   }
117: 
118:   public void testSingleSentence() throws Exception {
119:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
120:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
121:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
122:     bi.setText(getCharArrayIterator(SENTENCES[0]));
123:     test1Sentence(bi, SENTENCES[0]);
124:   }
125: 
126:   private void test1Sentence(BreakIterator bi, String text) {
127:     int start = bi.getText().getBeginIndex();
128:     assertEquals(start, bi.first());
129:     int current = bi.current();
130:     assertEquals(bi.getText().getEndIndex(), bi.next());
131:     int end = bi.current() - start;
132:     assertEquals(text, text.substring(current - start, end - start));
133: 
134:     assertEquals(text.length(), bi.last() - start);
135:     end = bi.current();
136:     bi.previous();
137:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.previous());
138:     int previous = bi.current();
139:     assertEquals(text, text.substring(previous - start, end - start));
140:     assertEquals(start, bi.current());
141: 
142:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.following(bi.last() / 2 + start));
143: 
144:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.preceding(bi.last() / 2 + start));
145: 
146:     assertEquals(start, bi.first());
147:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.next(13));
148:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.next(-8));
149:   }
150: 
151:   public void testSliceEnd() throws Exception {
152:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
153:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
154:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
155:     bi.setText(getCharArrayIterator(SENTENCES[0] + PADDING, 0, SENTENCES[0].length()));
156: 
157:     test1Sentence(bi, SENTENCES[0]);
158:   }
159: 
160:   public void testSliceStart() throws Exception {
161:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
162:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
163:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
164:     bi.setText(
165:         getCharArrayIterator(PADDING + SENTENCES[0], PADDING.length(), SENTENCES[0].length()));
166:     test1Sentence(bi, SENTENCES[0]);
167:   }
168: 
169:   public void testSliceMiddle() throws Exception {
170:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
171:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
172:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
173:     bi.setText(
174:         getCharArrayIterator(
175:             PADDING + SENTENCES[0] + PADDING, PADDING.length(), SENTENCES[0].length()));
176: 
177:     test1Sentence(bi, SENTENCES[0]);
178:   }
179: 
180:   /** the current position must be ignored, initial position is always first() */
181:   public void testFirstPosition() throws Exception {
182:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
183:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
184:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
185:     bi.setText(getCharArrayIterator(SENTENCES[0]));
186:     assertEquals(SENTENCES[0].length(), bi.last()); // side-effect: set current position to last()
187:     test1Sentence(bi, SENTENCES[0]);
188:   }
189: 
190:   public void testWhitespaceOnly() throws Exception {
191:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
192:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
193:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
194:     bi.setText("   \n \n\n\r\n\t  \n");
195:     test0Sentences(bi);
196:   }
197: 
198:   public void testEmptyString() throws Exception {
199:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
200:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
201:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
202:     bi.setText("");
203:     test0Sentences(bi);
204:   }
205: 
206:   public void testPrecedingWithTwoSentences() throws IOException {
207:     NLPSentenceDetectorOp sentenceDetectorOp =
208:         OpenNLPOpsFactory.getSentenceDetector(sentenceModelFile);
209:     BreakIterator bi = new OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator(sentenceDetectorOp);
210:     bi.setText("This is sentence one. This is sentence two.");
211: 
212:     // set pos to somewhere in the second sentence
213:     int precedingSentence = bi.preceding(25);
214:     assertEquals(0, precedingSentence);
215:   }
216: 
217:   private void test0Sentences(BreakIterator bi) {
218:     assertEquals(0, bi.current());
219:     assertEquals(0, bi.first());
220:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.next());
221:     assertEquals(0, bi.last());
222:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.previous());
223:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.following(0));
224:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.preceding(0));
225:     assertEquals(0, bi.first());
226:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.next(13));
227:     assertEquals(BreakIterator.DONE, bi.next(-8));
228:   }
229: }

(End of file - total 229 lines)

part.text:
Fixed `OpenNLPSentenceBreakIterator.preceding`’s binary-search midpoint:

- Changed `lastSpanCount / 2` to `(lastSpanCount - 1) / 2`.
- This keeps `currentSentence` within the valid searchable sentence range when exactly two sentences are present, preventing the out-of-bounds read.
